components.TextLink: src/app/ pages (.arrow-link, .prompt-list and prose links in src/styles/site.css)

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground, a near-black green (#080c0b). Header, main and footer sit on it, and the brand mark and the browser `theme-color` use the same value.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text: titles, running text, card titles, Uses values. Also the hover colour of nav, footer and contact links. 14.6:1 on `background`, 14.3:1 on `card-bg`, 13.2:1 on `muted`.

tokens.name: card-bg
tokens.usage: The fill of every card and panel: ArticleRows, AI tool cards, project cards, the hero facts panel, the older/newer article links. Declared in `src/styles/site.css`, one small step above `background`, so a card is drawn by its `border` more than its fill.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: The shadcn surface alias. No component uses it: cards use `card-bg`.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card` (14.2:1).

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: The shadcn floating-surface alias. Nothing on the site floats today.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover` (14.0:1).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The muted green accent (#6cd79d), for what you can act on or what is current: links, the shell glyphs (`$`, the `>` before prompts, `//`, `-`, `##`), the Brand, the current nav item, the Button's border and hover fill, the hero cursor, the About lead and the contact headline. 11.1:1 on `background`, 10.9:1 on `card-bg`, 10.0:1 on `muted`.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill: the Button on hover (11.1:1).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: The shadcn secondary fill. Unused on the site.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary` (12.9:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills inside Articles: inline code chips and table header cells.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, meta lines, inactive nav and footer links, the shell command above a page title, the `>` before a title, Uses keys and notes, the `/` before nav links, the ↗ external marker. Also a card's border on hover. 8.0:1 on `background`, 7.8:1 on `card-bg`, 7.2:1 on `muted`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The green wash behind selected text.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Selected text on `accent` (11.3:1).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors only, always with a word, never colour alone. Nothing on the site uses it today. 5.6:1 on `background`, 5.5:1 on `card-bg`.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `destructive` fill (5.6:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The 1px line everywhere: the header and footer rules, home section dividers, card and panel edges, tags, Uses row dividers, tables and code blocks. It is decorative (1.4:1), so a card's title link, not its edge, tells you it is clickable.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: The shadcn form-field border, the same value as `border`. The site has no forms.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline: 2px solid with a 2px offset on every focusable element. A focused card title draws it around the whole card. Equals `primary`, so it is at least 10:1 on every surface.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: `--text-display`, `clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 2.75rem)`: 30px up to about 670px wide, 41.25px from about 920px, recorded here at its maximum. Page titles only: the home hero and the h1 in every PageHeader, after a `>` prompt in `muted-foreground`, with wrapped lines hanging under the text. Balance-wrapped.

styles.name: text-lg
styles.usage: `--text-lg`, 1.5rem. Subheadings: an Article's h2 (after `## ` in `primary`) and the home contact headline (in `primary`, leading 1.1, tracking -0.02em).

styles.name: text-md
styles.usage: `--text-md`, 1.125rem. Card and section titles and ledes: ArticleRow and project titles, SectionHead titles (after `// `, tracking 0.02em), AI tool names, an Article's h3, the About lead.

styles.name: text-base
styles.sample: Software engineer shipping web apps since 2014.
styles.usage: `--text-base`, 1rem: the 15px root. All running text, Articles included: the hero lead, PageHeader descriptions (leading 1.6), Article body (leading 1.8, 600 for bold), Uses rows, the hero prompts.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.usage: `--text-sm`, 0.9rem. Nav, links and secondary text: MainNav, the Brand, the Button, "view all" links, the shell command above a page title, card descriptions (leading 1.7), the footer, the RSS line, code blocks (leading 1.65), Article tables.

styles.name: text-xs
styles.usage: `--text-xs`, 0.8rem: the floor, nothing is smaller. Dates, tags and labels: the ArticleRow and Article meta lines, tags, the older/newer labels, the copyright line, and the uppercase fact labels (tracking 0.08em on the hero, 0.02em on About).

spacing.note: Rem steps from src/styles/site.css, shown in px at the site's 15px root (space-N = N × 0.25rem). These are the steps the site uses.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 0.25rem. Under the uppercase hero fact labels; between key and value where Uses rows stack.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 0.5rem. Between tags; above and below an About link-list row; between header items when they wrap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 0.75rem. Between the parts of a card (meta, title, description, call to action); the Button's label-to-arrow gap; between a SectionHead's title and its link when they wrap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 1rem. Between AI tool cards and between the older/newer links; the footer's row gap; above the contact text.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: 1.25rem. The header's vertical padding; above the hero lead and a PageHeader description; under the shell command; the page gutter below 640px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 1.5rem. The page gutter (`--gutter`), the padding inside every card (`--card-pad`), the gap between ArticleRows, and the gap between a Uses key and its value.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: 2rem. From a SectionHead to its content; above the hero prompts and the contact actions; the footer's top padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: 2.5rem. Above an Article's h2 and its Cover Image; the footer's bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: 3rem. The main content's top padding; between the hero's two columns; between the blocks of the About body.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: 3.5rem. Above and below each home section, between its `border` rules; between the About columns.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: 4rem. Under a PageHeader; between sections on Uses and AI Tools; above an Article's footer.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: 5rem. The main content's bottom padding, before the footer.

radius.note: Cards use a fixed 4px. The shadcn steps come from `--radius: 0.375rem` and are shown in px at the 15px root.

tokens.name: card-radius
tokens.usage: Cards and panels, tags, the Button, the hero facts panel, the About portrait and an Article's Cover Image. A Cover Image inside an ArticleRow uses 0.6 of it (2.4px).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: `calc(var(--radius) - 4px)`. Inline code chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: `calc(var(--radius) - 2px)`. The skip link.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: `var(--radius)`. Code blocks and images inside an Article.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: `calc(var(--radius) + 4px)`. Defined by the shadcn mapping, unused.

layout.note: Measures from the page shell in src/styles/site.css, in px at the 15px root. Breakpoints are media queries, so their rem values use the browser's 16px.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: 60rem (`--container`). Max width of the header, main and footer content. Their `border` rules run the full window width.

tokens.name: article-width
tokens.usage: 46rem. The Article page's centred column. A PageHeader is at most 48rem (720px) and its description 38rem (570px).

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: 2.75rem (`min-h-11`). Minimum height of nav, footer, contact and "view all" links and of the Button. Links in lists are shorter: the hero and 404 prompts 2.25rem (33.75px), Uses, About and RSS-line links 1.75rem (26.25px).

tokens.name: min-target
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the short contact and RSS links ("X"), and the floor for any target (WCAG 2.5.8).

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline width, offset 2px, in `ring`.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: 52rem. Below it the hero and the About page drop to one column.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: 40rem. Below it the nav moves to its own row under the Brand, Uses rows and ArticleRows stack, and the gutter narrows to `space-5`.
